import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages;w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack();return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
cells={k:v.r.values for k,v in w.groupby(['genre','late'])}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
gs=sorted(set(k[0] for k in cells))
for i in range(4000):
  bs.append(np.mean([rng.choice(cells[(g,True)],len(cells[(g,True)])).mean()-rng.choice(cells[(g,False)],len(cells[(g,False)])).mean() for g in gs]))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]),np.std(bs))
for dc in [['high'],['high','medium']]:
  print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence.isin(dc)]))
print('nooth',est(w[~w.genre.isin(['other','collection'])]))
print('1856-1895',est(w[(w.year>1855)&(w.year<1896)]))
print('UK',est(w[w.origin=='UK']),'US',est(w[w.origin=='US']))
print(w[w[c]>0].groupby('late').sample(4,random_state=1)[['passage_ids','year','genre']].to_string())
"
